daoris: `remote add` needs a workspace name — e.g. `daoris remote add aurora`. The name is the workspace, and it is what a shared deployment declares itself to be.

daoris: unknown driver verb 'frobnicate' — one of: list, drive, undrive, hold, resume, trees, line, landing, across, notify, strikes, retry, timeout, cooloff, cap, adapter, intake, helper
daoris: `driver drive` needs a name — e.g. `daoris driver drive aurora-engine`.
daoris: `driver cooloff` needs a whole number of minutes, at least 1 — e.g. `daoris driver cooloff 60`; a zero cool-off would start a spent account again at every look.
daoris: `agent profile order` needs the accounts, in order, or --clear — e.g. `daoris agent profile order claude-code account-1 account-2`.
daoris: `fastest` is not a way to use accounts — goal (make the most of them) or order (one by one, in order). An account is kept for conversations with `--keep <account>`.
daoris: `agent profile ready` needs <agent> <profile>|--own — e.g. `daoris agent profile ready claude-code account-1`, or `--own` for the tool's own sign-in.
daoris: unknown plugin verb 'frobnicate' — one of: list, add, update, remove, enable, disable (and new, try: the kit)
daoris: `plugin add` needs a folder holding a `plugin.json` — e.g. `daoris plugin add ./acme.quiet-hours`.

daoris: `browser` takes `daoris browser favorite list`, `daoris browser favorite add <address> [--title T]`, `daoris browser favorite remove <address>`, `daoris browser extensions [offer|refuse]`, `daoris browser use [daoris|edge]`, or `daoris browser links [system|daoris]`.
